sources.label: Personal patch bundle for Morphe
sources.author: dieroboter
patch_list: Disables the Google UMP consent flow that gates ad loading. The consent info update never runs and ads are treated as always allowed to load. Has no visible effect if 'Remove banner ads' is also enabled.
Disables Firebase Crashlytics data collection and empties the app's Crashlytics log/exception calls, which otherwise report the server URL and configuration on every start and stop.
Stops the server from announcing itself as 'WiFiFTP' over mDNS/NSD (_ftp._tcp) on the local network. Direct connections by IP address are unaffected.
Hides the 'Get Pro version' button on the main screen, which only opens the paid Pro app's store listing.
Replaces the legacy launcher icon with a Material You adaptive icon: white folder and WiFi glyph on the app's blue, with a monochrome layer for themed icons.
Removes the AdMob banner ad from the main screen. The ads SDK is never initialized and the banner view is never created or loaded.
Remove Rate this app menu item
Removes the 'Rate this app' item, which opens the app's store listing, from the main screen menu.
Strip ad tracking permissions and app ID
Removes the AdMob application ID, the MobileAds initialization provider and the ad identifier permissions (AD_ID and Ad Services) from the manifest. Requires 'Remove banner ads'.
